items.text: What would you do if you won a jet?

*

Dear MrBeast,
My name is Talha, I am 20 years old from Pakistan.
Please help me. I love a girl from Philippines and we want to marry in halal way, but I have no money for her visa, ticket and marriage.I would be very thankful if you help us. You change many lives, please change my life too please
J’ai tellement envie de participer à l’un de tes jeux malheureusement j’suis en Haïti😩
Mrbeast mujhe bhi game mein le lo 😢 please 🥺52.6 crore
If i won a jet i travel with my family all world 🌍
The games in these MrBeast videos are so easy that I could win three of them at the same time; if I don’t win, I’ll post a video in which I say his name one hundred thousand times.

WOW MrBeast! ✈❤

100 pilots competing for a private jet? This is absolutely incredible!

I love how you turned the dream of owning a private jet into such an exciting competition. Bringing together 100 pilots and giving them the chance to compete for something this extraordinary is truly next level. The creativity and scale of your challenges never stop amazing me!

Watching this video made me dream even bigger about becoming part of one of your challenges someday.

Let me introduce myself.

My name is Sourabh Das. I am 27 years old, and I come from Murshidabad, West Bengal, India.

I come from a financially modest background. Unfortunately, I cannot currently afford an international passport or travel expenses. My English is also not very strong, but I am willing to learn, improve, and give my absolute best.

I know you receive millions of comments, but I sincerely hope someone from your casting team notices my message.

I am not asking for money or special treatment. I am simply asking for ONE opportunity to participate in an upcoming MrBeast video.

I want to challenge myself, meet people from around the world, and represent my hometown, Murshidabad, and West Bengal on a global stage.

**MrBeast Casting Team, if you are looking for new international contestants for upcoming challenges, please consider giving me a chance!**

Name: Sourabh Das
Age: 27
Location: Murshidabad, West Bengal, India

Thank you, MrBeast, for inspiring millions of people to dream beyond their limits.

I hope one day I get to say: "I was a contestant in a MrBeast video!" ❤

With hope and respect,
Sourabh Das
